objective: Deliver Sully Balloo's Letter to Sara Balloo.
start: Found in Waterlogged Letter in Arathi Highlands

description: The waterlogged and war-torn envelope dissolves in your hands, leaving you with a few pages of a letter in your grasp, written with painstaking care.
The letter is addressed to a Mrs. Sara Balloo of Ironforge and begins, "My dear Sara...."
progress: You look as though you have traveled a great distance and seen much turmoil in your time, <class>. These times we live in are trying on the soul. What news do you bring to me now?
completion: You say you saw my Sully pinned beneath the icy waters? Say it isn't so!
Let me read what he wrote....
